text:
alex: quick handoff — i'm primary for the next 4h (until ~02:00 UTC). active alert set: KV cache evictions spike in eu-west-1 + embeddings queue backlog. paging history attached by incident-bot below.

incident-bot: Pager alert: `KV_CACHE_EVICTIONS_HIGH` in eu-west-1 (p99 token latency up). Triggered 3m ago, severity: P2.

alex: summary of current state: one of the cache tiers is thrashing after a config push last night. customers seeing transient 5xxs on long-generation jobs (mainly embeddings + rerank flows). estimated affected traffic ~3-6% in eu-west; big customers on dedicated may be rerouted.

maya: thanks. i saw a regen error from cust-acme around 10:12 local — they reported timeouts on 50k token jobs. looks correlated.

sanjay: root cause hypothesis: kv eviction policy changed to LFU via the canary, eviction rate jumped under the embeddings workload. queued embeddings tasks are piling because workers block on cache miss cold-starts.

zara: mitigation in progress: we rolled routing to secondary kv-store in eu-west at 10:18 (sticky sessions still hitting primary for some flows). working on failing over short-lived jobs to secondary; long jobs remain on primary.

alex: actions taken (so far):
- rolled partial route-to-secondary for short jobs (<=30s)
- increased `max_inflight_prefetch` to reduce miss amplification
- paused latest kv canary config (reverted at 10:25)
- added temporary rate-limit on embeddings generator for non-enterprise tier (throttle to 60rps)

ops-bot: Deploy rollback: `kv-config-canary` reverted by zara at 10:25 — deployment id 2026-319.

leo: current numbers from dashboards: eu-west p99 for text gen 1.9s -> 4.8s, embeddings queue length +320 over baseline, eviction rate from 120/s -> 1200/s.

maya: customer impact note: three paying customers saw >30s timeouts on regenerate endpoints. support ticket ids: #8231 (acme), #8235 (beta-corp), #8240 (edu-rl). raising priority in support.

sanjay: runbook references: KV eviction playbook -> https://go/runbooks/kv-eviction ; embeddings queue playbook -> https://go/runbooks/embeddings-queue. If you are oncall and see increase again, follow the containment steps under "eviction backpressure".

alex: immediate tasks for next oncall (maya) — i'm leaving detailed checklist: 
1) keep primary as warm-only for long jobs; actively monitor `primary_swap_errors` dashboard.
2) if eviction rate > 800/s AND p99 > 4s, escalate to RTE team (ping @sanjay and @zara).
3) if customer-visible 5xxs continue > 10m, initiate global short-job routing (already scripted) with:
```
# short-job route script
./tools/route_short_jobs --region eu-west-1 --target secondary --dry-run=false
```
4) run the helper to drain embeddings queue on secondary: `scripts/queue_drain --limit 1000`

maya: acknowledged — i'll take primary at 10:40 UTC. i'll run through the checklist and post status every 15m.

zara: ops note: we have a small coverage gap for the AM pacific window (02:00-05:00 PDT) — only leo will be awake/online in rotations; please coordinate preemptively with leo if more manual failover needed.

leo: can confirm i will be on standby 02:00-06:00 UTC. if you handoff further, leave the runbooks link + the debug command snippets i'm likely to need.

alex: leaving quick debug snippets below (copy/paste):
```
# show eviction metrics
curl -sS 'https://internal-metrics/eu-west/kv/evictions' | jq .last_15m
# check embedding queue
kubectl -n inference exec -it queue-runner -- /bin/sh -c "python manage.py queue_status --region eu-west"
```

sanjay: note on rollback safety: the canary was reverted, but config propagation may take up to 8 mins. if you see a second bump, assume half of hosts still had updated config.

maya: status update 10:50 UTC — routing to secondary holding, queues slowly draining, p99 down to 3.4s. i've notified support to patch tickets.

alex: any blockers for next 30m?

maya: none immediate. i'll keep watch. escalation path: page @oncall-rte if metrics cross thresholds. if paging fails, call sanjay at +1-555-0199.

incident-bot: Alert cleared: `KV_CACHE_EVICTIONS_HIGH` in eu-west-1 at 11:07 UTC (status: degraded -> recovering).

alex: final notes for handoff: primary -> maya, secondary -> leo on-call backup; if maya is unavailable, leo should accept full prim/sec. document in the ticket: what changed (reverted canary, temporary throttles), and run a postmortem if we get recurrence.

maya: got it. leaving active watch til 12:30 UTC and will hand off then unless stable earlier. adding tasks to the incident board: investigate LFU vs LRU profile mismatch, and add safety limit to canary push.

zara: copied. if anyone needs the canary diff: `git show kv-config-canary@{1}`.

alex: thanks team. handing off now. :wave:
